card.desc: A machine coming to life. Servos, then a settled hum.
card.prompt: a large science fiction machine powering on, deep servo whir then settling electrical hum, designed sound effect, close
card.negative: music, speech, alarm, explosion, crowd, reverb, human
card.note: The settled hum at the end is what makes it loopable into a room tone.

peak_limited.why: audition copy had no peak ceiling; the film bus already limits to -3 dBTP
